d:
Popatlal returns to Gokuldham Society from Bhopal in the middle of the night, sparking a massive argument with his tempo driver, Satwant Singh, over the fare. Satwant demands ₹15,000 for extra mileage, detours, and fines caused by Popatlal’s meddling, while Popatlal refuses to pay more than ₹7,000.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
